description: This PHP class 'CandidateAttachmentDecorator' provides methods to access and manipulate candidate attachment data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functionality to retrieve file content from candidate attachments, use of traits for ORM helper methods, and the ability to associate candidates with attachments.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional functionality for CandidateAttachment entities, including file content retrieval and candidate association.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a CandidateAttachment object.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the file content from the candidate attachment, supporting resource conversion to string.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Associates a candidate with the attachment using the candidate's ID.
